# Odyssey Insights Counseling LLC

> Private-pay couples therapy (Gottman Method, EFT) and trauma recovery (EMDR, CPT, TF-CBT) in St. Cloud, Minnesota and statewide via telehealth, led by Brian Oduguwa, MSW, LICSW.

## Clinician & Practice Profile
- **Provider:** Brian Oduguwa, MSW, LICSW (Minnesota Board of Social Work License #22350)
- **Experience:** 13+ years in clinical social work; Board-Approved Clinical Supervisor; Military Veteran; MSW from St. Cloud State University (2013)
- **Practice Name:** Odyssey Insights Counseling LLC
- **Phone:** (320) 322-8118
- **Website:** https://www.odysseyinsightscounseling.com/
- **Service Area:** St. Cloud, MN (56301, 56303), Sartell, Waite Park, Sauk Rapids, Central Minnesota, and statewide across Minnesota via HIPAA-compliant telehealth (in-person St. Cloud office opening soon)
- **Hours:** Weekday daytime, weekday evenings, and Saturdays

## Core Clinical Specialties & Modalities
- **Couples & Marriage Therapy (Primary Niche):** Gottman Method Couples Therapy, Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), attachment-based therapy, infidelity/affair recovery, premarital counseling
- **Trauma & PTSD Therapy (Secondary Specialty):** Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT), Trauma-Focused CBT (TF-CBT)
- **Populations Served:** Couples in distress, adults (18+), military veterans, active-duty/National Guard service members, first responders (police, fire, EMS), healthcare professionals, men's issues, and BIPOC/diverse clients seeking culturally responsive care

## Fees & Payment Model
- **Couples Therapy (90 minutes, CPT 90847):** $180 per session
- **Individual Therapy (60 minutes, CPT 90837):** $150 per session
- **Initial Consultation (15 minutes):** Free
- **Insurance & Payment:** Private-pay / out-of-pocket (HSA and FSA accepted). Monthly itemized superbills provided for out-of-network insurance reimbursement.
